ModDescription: Hold a key to auto-fill/harvest machines and fertilize crops around you.
Config.TriggerKey.Name: Trigger Key
Config.TriggerKey.Desc: The key to hold for auto-action.
Config.IntervalMs.Name: Interval (ms)
Config.EnableMachineHarvest.Name: Enable Machine Harvest
Config.EnableMachineHarvest.Desc: Whether to harvest finished machines automatically.
Config.EnableMachineFill.Name: Enable Machine Fill
Config.EnableMachineFill.Desc: Whether to fill empty machines with matching items from your hand.
Config.EnableFertilize.Name: Enable Fertilize
Config.EnableFertilize.Desc: Whether to fertilize unfertilized soil if you are holding fertilizer.
